chunks: It is narrated that when Ja'far was born to Abul Hasan (peace be upon him), people congratulated him, but they did not see any signs of joy in him,
He was asked about it. The Imam replied, “Take his birth easy; he will misguide many.”

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, a title for Imam Hasan al-Askari
key_terms.جَعْفَر: Ja'far, son of Imam Hasan al-Askari

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Hasan al-Askari not show joy at the birth of his son Ja'far?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the theological distinction between the two sons of Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s.), Ja'far and Muhammad, by noting the Imam's lack of joy at Ja'far's birth due to his future role as a major rival claimant to the Imamate. Historically, this refers to Ja'far al-Sadiq (not to be confused with the later Imam) who became the leader of the 'Ja'fariyya' sect, leading many to believe he was the true Imam during the Minor Occultation, thus causing confusion and misguidance among the general populace.
